paper: Jayaraman & Wu (2020), Should I Stay or Should I Grow?, RFS 33(8)
annotator: Checked line by line against the published RFS PDF by member D; page numbers are PDF pages of the published version.
rule: Values record what the paper states. If the paper does not state a field, the value is null. Notes cite the paper only.

sample_filters: firms making annual capex forecasts covered by IBES, matched to Compustat with the IBES link file
matched with CRSP for the short-window market reaction
delete forecasts made concurrently with an earnings forecast
fields.dependent_var: CAPEX_ADJ: percentage deviation of actual capex from forecasted capex scaled by the forecast
key_independent_vars: CAR: cumulative abnormal returns over the 5 days around the forecast date, standardized
CAR_POS: positive market reactions, zero otherwise, standardized
CAR_NEG: negative market reactions, zero otherwise, standardized
controls: MKTRET: S&P 500 market return on the forecast date, standardized
CAR_PRE: 5-day market reaction around a non-forecast date two weeks before the forecast, standardized
SIZE: log market value of equity
SURP: quarterly EPS minus EPS of the same quarter a year earlier
EA_DUM: forecast accompanied by an earnings announcement
fields.standard_errors: robust standard errors clustered by industry
fields.subsamples: split by whether event-period [-2,2] bid-ask spreads are higher than pre-event [-10,-3] spreads (lower vs higher); columns 1-2 use CAR, columns 3-4 split CAR into CAR_POS and CAR_NEG

notes.winsorization: No statement about winsorizing, trimming or outliers anywhere in the paper.
notes.standard_errors: Clustered 'by industry' (p.14); the paper does not define the industry classification.
notes.controls: The Table 3 note (p.14) refers to 'Model 9 of Table 2', but Table 2 (p.11) has only eight columns — a numbering slip in the paper itself; the full-controls specification is Model 8. LAG_CAPX: the Table 1 note (p.9) reports it 'in US$ millions', while the Table 2 note (p.11) defines the regression control as 'the most recent year's annual capex scaled by start of year market value' (also 'scaled by market value' on p.12) — the descriptive-statistics variable and the control differ in scaling.
notes.subsamples: Split rule on p.13; the paper does not state the source of the bid-ask spread data.
notes.sample_filters: Filters on p.8; 'concurrent with an earnings forecast' is not defined further.
notes.key_independent_vars: Standardization stated in the Table 3 note (p.14); whether CAR_POS/CAR_NEG are split before or after standardizing is not stated.
notes.model: The paper says 'we regress'; OLS is not named explicitly.
